_comment: Copy to /data/profanity.json to tune the filter. These lists are MERGED with the built-in defaults in server/profanity.js.
_words: Matched as whole words after normalization.
_strict: Also hunted inside a single word and across runs of 1-2 character tokens (the 'f u c k' evasion signature). Keep these unambiguous — a short term here will fire inside innocent words.
_allow: Innocent words that would otherwise trip the filter.
